0022600204.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-7, 10th in the East, 4th in the Southeast) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (5-4, 6th in the East, 2nd in the Central) in the Hornets' 11th game of the season, with Charlotte on a six-game losing streak and 2-4 at home. Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, all out, while Brandon Miller and Moussa Diabate are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen, Jaylon Tyson and Sam Merrill, all out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 118-113 loss in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
